item.title: Florida Georgia Line Signs With The Core Entertainment Following CMA Fest Reunion
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome back to the show, folks. We've got some exciting news for country music fans out there. Florida Georgia Line, one of the most successful country duos, is back in business together. Let's dive into the details."
[Music transitions]
Host: "According to Billboard, Florida Georgia Line has signed with The Core Entertainment for management. This comes after Tyler Hubbard, one half of the duo, had already been working with The Core as a solo act. Now, the entire group, which includes Hubbard and Brian Kelley, is on board."
[Music transitions]
Host: "You might remember that Florida Georgia Line went on hiatus back in 2022, with each member releasing solo music. But, it looks like they're reuniting and ready to get back to work. In fact, they just made a surprise appearance at CMA Fest, announcing 'We back, baby!' after playing some of their biggest hits like 'Round Here' and 'Cruise'."
[Music clip: "Cruise" by Florida Georgia Line plays]
Host: "Tyler Hubbard took the stage at Nissan Stadium, saying 'CMA Fest, it feels so good to be here with my brother... We back, baby!' And it looks like they're not just talking the talk. Billboard has learned that more live shows are coming in 2027."
[Music transitions]
Host: "Now, there's no word on whether they're working on new music, but with The Core Entertainment on board, it's likely we'll see some big things from Florida Georgia Line in the near future. The duo has been dropping hints about a reunion for a while now, including a cryptic Instagram post from Brian Kelley back in January."
[Music transitions]
Host: "Florida Georgia Line has had an incredible run, with hits like 'Round Here', 'Stay', and 'H.O.L.Y.'. And with The Core Entertainment, which also manages acts like Nickelback and Dan + Shay, we can expect big things from this country powerhouse. We'll be keeping an eye on this story and bringing you updates as more information comes out."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today, folks. Thanks for tuning in. We'll catch you on the next one."
